情報処理教科書 出るとこだけ！基本情報技術者［科目B］予想＋過去問題集
observations: 科目Bの擬似言語はプログラムのトレース技能を中心に問う。
擬似言語の主要学習領域として文法、一次元配列、二次元配列、再帰、木構造、オブジェクト指向、リスト、スタック・キュー、ビット列が整理されている。
令和8年度向け問題集では、科目Bは擬似言語16問と情報セキュリティ4問の構成として整理されている。
同問題集は現行科目Bの情報セキュリティでは暗号、デジタル署名・証明書等の認証、PKI、セキュアプロトコルを出題範囲外とし、人・組織による管理面、事故対応、現場ケースの判断を重視している。
reference_policy.copyright: scope/structure/difficulty calibration only; no proprietary question wording copied

coverage.assessment: major algorithm/pseudocode coverage is broad; no major domain gap found

medium_reasons.loop_sum: two checkpoints are straightforward accumulation; the second is essentially the final arithmetic step
medium_reasons.stack_ops: both checkpoints ask the same LIFO POP rule with minimal intervening state reasoning
medium_reasons.count_even: both checkpoints explicitly state that the value is even and only ask count+1
medium_reasons.matrix_sum: both checkpoints are direct addition; the second is the final total
medium_reasons.queue_ops: both checkpoints repeat the same FIFO DEQUEUE rule
medium_reasons.object_counter: both checkpoints repeat the same one-step inc() update

prediction_authenticity.assessment: basic progression is useful, but six exercises under-train the intended trace skill because their paired checkpoints are redundant or nearly mechanical

compound_quality.assessment: 15 sets x 3 questions provide useful progression; no catastrophic duplicate/template defect found

security_quality.high_reason: current Subject B scope mismatch against the attached 令和8年度 Subject B reference

high_details.certificate: digital certificate / CA mechanics are explicitly in the excluded authentication/PKI area
high_details.crypto_choice: symmetric/public-key cryptography selection and key transport are in the excluded cryptography area
high_details.password_hash: hash/salt password storage is technical cryptography knowledge rather than the current management/case-study emphasis
high_details.signed_update: digital-signature verification and public/private-key roles are in the excluded authentication/signature area

security_quality.final_exam_risk: final practice selects security cases from the same 15-scenario pool, so out-of-scope cases can enter the 4-question security portion and reduce exam realism

explanation_feedback.reason: the six weak basic exercises explain only the immediate arithmetic/operation and do not teach a richer trace table or divergence point
explanation_feedback.exam_mode_hints: algorithm mini-mock candidate objects omit hint fields and present code/state/question/options without training hints; explanations appear in review

recommended_v200.scope: replace the four out-of-scope security scenarios first; do not mix algorithm checkpoint rewrites into the same batch
recommended_v200.engineering_prerequisite: current content-release validator dumps and diffs only QUESTION_BANK (Subject A); v200 must add a narrow Subject B content-release validation path for SECURITY_SCENARIOS before learner edits
validation_requirements: exactly declared security scenario IDs may change
security mock quotas remain 2/4/2 and final remains 16 algorithm + 4 security
